reason: Changing this would alter which criteria count toward the gate, and with it the missing-evidence and verified outcomes.
This decides whether a criterion is reported as missing passing evidence, which drives a partial versus verified status.
This decides whether the no-evidence partial path, its risk and its summary text apply.
This decides whether research-only is returned even when blocked or failed evidence exists.
The research-only check runs before the blocked and failed checks, so a disabled research run hides failures.
This decides whether a blocked status is reported.
Blocked takes precedence over failed when both kinds of evidence exist.
This decides whether a failed status is reported.
Failed takes precedence over the disabled-policy partial status.
A disabled gate must never be reported as verified.
This is the only path that yields a verified completion.
This keeps not-applicable criteria from being reclassified.
This decides the per-criterion verified or unverified status.
This decides whether residual risk from passing evidence is reported.
This selects which no-evidence risk message is reported.
This function only computes a criterion's status from its arguments.
